checks.label: Unless otherwise stated, valves are drawn in their normal position, the primary flowpath: the cooling sheet opens with every valve open, one pump running, the other stopped, and the water lit through the cooler
Isolation points on the plant must match the line diagram: the plant sketch has exactly one valve the drawing lacks, on the header tank's line, and it is drawn shut
With P1 running and every valve open, water lights all the way round through the cooler; shut V7 and nothing is lit, and P1 runs against a shut valve
NR2 stops water running back through the stopped P2: its branch stays dark, but with NR2 taken out, P1's water would run back through P2
TV1 always leaves an outlet open: at full bypass the water still goes round, through the bypass and not the cooler; some each way lights both
Whatever the lineup, no lit pipe ends at a shut valve, no water passes a non-return valve backwards, nothing flows with both pumps stopped, and the header tank's line never lights
Isolating P2 takes V3 and V4: with both shut no red is left; V3 alone leaves its discharge red through NR2 to V4, and V4 alone leaves its suction red to V3
On the fuel sheet, with F1 shut and F2 and X1 open, P3 draws from tank 2 only; with X1 shut, from tank 1 only; with P3 stopped, nothing moves
To open S2 with X1 open takes three valves, F1, X1 and F3; shutting X1 already cuts off tank 2, so F2 adds nothing; the field asks exactly this
Worked by hand: with the valve open, 30 − 0.04 × 200 = 22 m; shut, q = 0 and the head is 30 m; the slips are the open-valve head and no head at all

Before an answer nothing gives it away: screens 3, 7 and 13 show no flow, screen 5 leaves P2's branch untraced, screen 9 shows no red and names no cut-off, screen 11 shows no ghost, screen 14 no red and no rings, and the say line names NR2 only from screen 5 on
3-way valves are sometimes drawn in the position they fail to: the sheet carries Note 1 for TV1, its drawn setting is through the cooler, and the air-fails puzzle answers through the cooler
Every demonstration settles within 4.5 s, and every answer's motion within 3 s
